How to compress an image?

You can reduce JPG or PNG image size directly from your browser using our free image compressor.

  1. Select a JPG or PNG image.
  2. Choose the desired image quality.
  3. Click Compress Image.
  4. Download the compressed image.

Why compress images?

Large images take more storage space and can take longer to upload or share. Compressing images can help reduce their file size.
